operator_io_quirks: MenuItem has 1,334,410 rows; Dish 426,713 — both exceed max_rows_per_table=300000, so original_values are rowid-sampled (rowid % k = 0) while original_sizes use full count(*).
Menu.date is declared DATE but stored as TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD' (e.g. '1900-04-15'); ts_fuzzer dispatches to Date (first element not int-parsable) with template %Y-%m-%d.
Menu.keywords, Menu.language, Menu.location_type are 100% NULL (distinct=0, samples empty) — literal pool and original_values are empty; String sampler gets no elements.
Dish.description is 100% NULL (distinct=1, sample '') — effectively empty column.
Menu.status has distinct=1 ('complete') — single-value column; String sampler will mostly reproduce it.
MenuItem.created_at / updated_at are TEXT holding 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC' — String fuzzer, not Date; no date template applies.
MenuPage.image_id declared REAL, storage real+null, values like 1603595.0 — Number(scale from REAL, no args) → scale 0, range [-1,1] full-range; original values far outside.
MenuItem.dish_id storage includes 'null' though null_rate=0.0 (sample shows integer) — storage-class list is a superset; treat null_rate as authoritative.
MenuItem.menu_page_id distinct=4759 but MenuPage.id distinct=66937 — FK child values are a strict subset of parent ids; parent has many unreferenced ids.
Dish.id and MenuItem.id both distinct=200000 (capped sample) though row counts differ (426713 / 1334410) — distinct counts are sample-capped, not true cardinality.
No composite PKs, no self-FKs, no dangling FKs, no unique/check constraints in DDL — all FKs resolve to existing single-column INTEGER PKs.
Table/column names are mixed-case (Dish, MenuPage, MenuItem, menu_page_id) — must be double-quoted; column lookup case-insensitive.
operator_ts_expectations: Date fuzzer on Menu.date: template %Y-%m-%d, range from parsed elements (~1900-1980s), so fresh dates stay in that window; implausible for 'modern' queries but plausible for menu-era queries.

Number fuzzer on REAL columns (price, high_price, xpos, ypos, image_id) with no (a,b) args → scale 0, full range [-1,1] (or [0,2] unsigned); original prices 0.1-25 and image_id ~1.6e6 are far outside → FN on price/image_id predicates.

Number fuzzer on INTEGER columns (id, menus_appeared, first_appeared, page_count, dish_count) → scale 0, range [-1,1] plus ±1/±2 perturbation; original ids up to 1.3M and years ~1900 → FN on id/year/count predicates.

String fuzzer on TEXT columns: 5 original samples + distinct pool literals, p=0.2 fresh random over a-zA-Z0-9() with contamination; names/places/uuids become gibberish → FN on LIKE/equality on name, place, uuid, call_number.
String fuzzer on 100%-NULL columns (keywords, language, location_type, description) has no elements → p:=1, always fresh random strings; original is all NULL → FP on IS NULL / FN on IS NOT NULL.
String fuzzer on Menu.status (single value 'complete') mostly reproduces 'complete' but contamination/fresh draws inject noise → occasional FP on status='complete'.

FK fill: MenuItem.menu_page_id drawn from MenuPage.id (66937 values) with replacement; MenuItem.dish_id from Dish.id (426713) — joins always match, so join-cardinality queries get plausible ties but wrong multiplicities.

PK dedup (sample_fresh_primary_keys) drops duplicate id rows; with Number fuzzer on id producing few distinct values, many rows collapse → table sizes shrink below chosen size → FN on COUNT(*) thresholds.
No NOT NULL/CHECK/unique constraints → no insert failures; all rows land, so row counts equal chosen sizes (minus PK dedup).
Menu.name null_rate 0.357 but String fuzzer rarely emits NULL (only via element dropout) → FP on name IS NULL queries.
Date fuzzer p-inversion: p=0.2 means element returned w.p. 0.2, fresh date w.p. 0.8 → dates mostly fresh in [min,max] of originals, ties on exact date rare → FP on date-equality joins.
Number list-range quirk (list_max overwritten to full-range max) means even with elements, fresh draws span [-1,1] not [min(el),max(el)] → price predicates like price>5 almost never satisfied → FN.
